page_title: BAY 3-1 PAU | Bayern Munich v St. Pauli 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' 3 - 1 Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Felix Zwayer signals that the goal stands! The Bayern Munich players celebrate.
90+6' Wait! Referee Felix Zwayer immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+6' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
90+3' 2 - 1 Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) receives the ball in the six-yard box and makes no mistake with the finish by burying it into the bottom left corner of the goal!
90+2' The statistic for corner kicks – 10:1.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
89' Bayern Munich are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.
87' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Connor Metcalfe comes onto the pitch to replace him.
85' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
83' Substitution. Aleksandar Pavlovic walks off the pitch and Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
83' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
81' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fails to score from inside the six-yard box as he sends his rebound against the left post.
81' It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
81' The resulting set piece from Bayern Munich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
78' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
77' Substitution. Min-Jae Kim will be replaced by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich).
76' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:9.
74' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Nikola Vasilj comes off the line to clear the ball away.
72' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
71' Wow, what an escape. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Bayern Munich get a corner.
70' It looks like Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) saw red with that tackle. Felix Zwayer won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
68' Here comes a substitution. Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Lars Ritzka.
68' The substitution has been made. Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) has replaced Jackson Irvine.
67' Flag goes up against Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
65' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Raphael Guerreiro will be replaced by Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich).
65' Substitution. Lennart Karl is replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
64' A lofted pass finds Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.
63' St. Pauli hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
61' The percentage of ball possession is – 81:19.
59' The linesman signals that Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
58' The corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence.
57' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
55' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.
52' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
51' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
50' The ball is cleared after Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
48' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincent Kompany probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Konrad Laimer. He is replaced by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Felix Zwayer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 1 Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets under the crossbar.
42' A player from St. Pauli pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
40' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Karol Mets (St. Pauli) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' POST! Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
33' Bayern Munich keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
31' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
30' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.

29' What a miss! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
29' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Zwayer interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
27' Bayern Munich are ruled offside.
25' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
23' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) can't believe his eyes as he misses a big opportunity to convert a rebound. The ball brushes the left post.

21' Bayern Munich are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
19' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
18' The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
18' Problems for Alexander Blessin as Andreas Hountondji is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) replaces him.

18' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
16' Ball possession – 81:19.
14' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
10' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
9' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
8' Bayern Munich are seeing far more of the ball now.
6' 0 - 1 Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
5' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
3' One of the players from St. Pauli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Felix Zwayer.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
